answer: Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the island is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, no identity may audit its own recruit. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. What survives to the zenith is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
